headline: KCR @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.90 at CHW 4.92, with a projected total of 9.82. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: KCR moved +0.13 runs while CHW moved +0.57, changing the projected margin by -0.44 runs. The projected total climbed +0.69, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Davis Martin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carter Jensen, Sam Antonacci, Miguel Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jacob Gonzalez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
